description: Covers measuring code health quantitatively: cyclomatic complexity, code duplication, coupling and cohesion, code churn, maintainability index, size conventions and documentation coverage - running radon, lizard, jscpd, interrogate and SonarQube-class tools, interpreting numbers against community conventions and the software's tier, wiring metric gates into CI, and avoiding metric gaming. Use when the user asks how healthy, complex or maintainable their code is, wants metrics or duplication measured, mentions cyclomatic complexity, churn, coupling or maintainability index, or when a quality assessment (rseng-quality-framework) needs the quantitative half. For style and linting see rseng-code-quality; for runtime performance measurement see rseng-performance-profiling.
